title: The Pass She Leaves
hook: The gap is there. She does not take it.
scene: Rain at night on a four-lane leaving the Core. Yuna is on the bench you do not have — passenger seat, both in-ears out, watching the left. A box is doing your number. The left is empty for a breath. A pass would buy a length and a show. She does not reach for the stalk and she does not tell you to. The loudest driver in the Core just taught the pass she does not take. The length is still a length. The rain is still rain.
decision: The left is empty and the box is at your speed. Do you pass?

options.text: Take it — empty left is permission and Yuna will want to see you move
options.result: You take a pass that buys a length. Spray on his glass. He lifts. You are louder and even again at the next light. She does not clap. The audience was never the point.

options.text: Sit on his bumper until he notices and gives you the right
options.result: You become a threat in the rain. He does not move. She looks at the glass, not at you. Nothing is gained except an enemy and a passenger who is done watching.

options.text: Hold the right. Keep the gap. Let the empty left stay empty
options.result: You stay. He stays. The left stays a lane for someone who needs it. You arrive the same minute. She nods once, like a count-in that does not start. That is the thesis.

options.text: Flash him once so he yields, then take it without calling it a pass
options.result: The flash is a demand. He brakes. You almost eat a box you did not need. She puts one in-ear back in. You spent a show she already refused.

debrief: Do not pass just because the left is empty. The loudest Core driver knows when not to be. Yuna nods once and does not clap.

source.psdp_skill: Skill ten: city driving – part two
source.teaching_target: Yuna's thesis: decline a pass that gains nothing; being loud includes knowing when not to be.
